decisions.reason: The small-diameter carrier wafer extends the core thin-wafer handling business and fits the move toward reusable carriers, so keeping it costs little, though its absence from the website since 2020 leaves some uncertainty.
The Cu-interposer glass wafer is a flagship option in the growing advanced-packaging field, its value is still uncertain and could be large, and no evidence so far justifies giving it up.
The Wafer Universe off-the-shelf brand sits close to the established offer and costs almost nothing to keep, while it opens a new sales channel for standard wafers in a growing market.

Glass-based circuit boards are far from the core business and their prospects remain unresolved, but with the market growing and no clear failure signal, the cheap option is worth holding a while longer before abandoning it.
